GeneDef.label: collective link
GeneDef.description:
A subspace neural transceiver wired into the brainstem links the carrier to every other drone in their faction. Knowledge, strength and even personality flow freely through the collective.

The collective only keeps what its drones carry. Lose a drone and you lose what it knew.

The link can't survive serving anyone but the collective: a drone that joins another faction burns out into a disconnected drone.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Each skill is performed at the collective's best level, as long as the drone that knows it is alive and linked.
Gains stat bonuses that grow with the number of linked drones. A lone drone is isolated and weakened.
Useful traits carried by one drone are shared with all drones.
Prisoners, slaves and severed drones are cut off from the collective.
Burns out if the carrier joins the player: they become a disconnected drone.

GeneDef.label: hive sovereign
GeneDef.description: The carrier is the voice and will of the collective. Nearby drones fight harder in her presence, but the whole structure depends on her: when she falls, the drones around her are severed from the collective.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Anyone she injects becomes a full drone immediately.
Drones on the same map count as a much larger collective.
If she is killed or captured, every drone on her map is severed from the collective for about two days.
When she falls, the collective raises a new queen.

GeneDef.label: severed link
GeneDef.description: The carrier once belonged to the Slorg collective. The transceiver in their brainstem is dead, but the silence where the collective used to be never quite goes away.\n\nSlorg nanoprobes destroy any genetic material taken from the carrier, so none of these genes can be extracted or passed on.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Genes cannot be extracted or reimplanted from this pawn.

GeneDef.label: nanoprobe swarm
GeneDef.description: Self-replicating nanoprobes patrol the bloodstream, sealing wounds and fighting infection.

GeneDef.label: drone conditioning
GeneDef.description: Individuality is irrelevant. Carriers barely register stress and have no interest at all in persuading, befriending or bargaining with anyone outside the collective.

customEffectDescriptions.li: No mental breaks while linked to the hive.

GeneDef.label: drone skin
GeneDef.description: Carriers have the pallid, grey skin of a Slorg drone.

GeneDef.label: queen skin
GeneDef.description: Carriers have the dark, metallic violet skin of a Slorg queen.
